title: Remove OneDrive
name: remove-onedrive
warning: Do NOT use if your Desktop, Documents, or Pictures are synced and stored exclusively in OneDrive cloud.
deepDescription: Uses registry, file system, and process commands to uninstall OneDrive, clean leftovers, and restore defaults—freeing RAM, CPU, and I/O by eliminating its background sync and startup tasks.
modal:
**When to use:** When you do not use Microsoft OneDrive cloud sync and want to stop its background sync/startup usage.

**When NOT to use:** If you rely on OneDrive to keep Desktop/Documents synced across PCs. Files will be moved back to your local user profile folder.
